text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp... Air Shakur 
trained right up until the very last 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The last time I came here was after the 
Nippon Derby, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Both I... and you. We have changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were practically ready to collapse 
last year. Looks like you actually learned 
your lesson.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
According to "Parcae," the probability of 
getting this far was zero.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even if it is just 0.01 millimeters, 
if you keep building upon it, it will 
eventually become 1.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once you reach one, how you build up from 
there is, in a sense... entirely up to 
you.
choice_data_list: Then you can become even stronger

Then, you'll be able to become even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Building things up step by step is your 
forte, right?

Building things up is your forte, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm used to it.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Bodyguard
text_block_list.text:
—Your Highness, I know it is presumptuous 
of me to speak, but... pushing your 
concentration to such extremes might take 
a toll on your health.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is quite natural. However, 
something of this level is not a problem.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to savor this wonderful feeling 
even more. It's like my very heart is 
riding on the wind, soaring far, far 
away...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Let's wrap it up after one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: She really loves running, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. Though apparently, she doesn't 
like it as much as her mission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that doing what I need to do 
will lead to connecting with her 
sincerely.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What a pain.

To Air Shakur, does it look like Fine 
Motion is resigning herself to fate?

The truth of the matter remains completely 
unknown. But if there is something she 
dislikes, she has the means to act. And 
that is...
choice_data_list: You can show them where you stand.
You can make them understand your stance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list:
Maybe if I watch you from now on, my heart 
will change too.

Maybe if I watch you from now on, my heart 
will change too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Not a 100% chance, that's for sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't happenin'. ...Though, if it ever 
did...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's a pain if we get caught. Let's go.

And so, our third summer training camp 
came to an end...
